name: Google Play
author: Enplace
summary: Keep an app's Google Play listing beside the product: its package, page and live version.
description: Goes on an app product that ships to Android. Add the package name and the Google Play page, and type the version that's live until the Play Console can be connected. With Release cycle on, the cycle numbers releases from that version. For iPhone and Mac, add App Store to the same product.

settings.name: Version live on Google Play
settings.help: Typed by hand until the Play Console is connected.
